hints.title: Online Top-K Tracking
hints.text: Maintain the k closest obstacle distances seen so far using a bounded priority container of capacity k.

hints.title: Heap Bound Eviction
hints.text: For each incoming obstacle distance abs(x) + abs(y), if the heap has fewer than k elements, push it. If distance is smaller than heap top, pop the maximum and push the new distance.

hints.title: Output Construction
hints.text: If heap contains fewer than k obstacles, append -1; otherwise append the top of the max-heap.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Each query performs logarithmic heap operations bounded by size k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the array per query takes O(q * q log q).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains bounded max-heap of size k for streaming k-th order statistics.
